headlines.text: Flash back to 2026, when The Infantry fought it out in a Cincinatti Street Fight match, in the night's main event on Collision, rated 8.24 ? a fantastic contest ? part of a stacked Summer Blockbuster '26 - Night 2 card, rated 8.18 overall. Continental Champion Jon Moxley and PAC of the Death Riders overpowered Shane Taylor Promotions' Carlie Bravo and Shawn Dean of The Infantry, closing it out with a double Death Rider on Dean.

Flash back to 2026, when Brody King chalked up their 100th recorded AEW match ? a hundred-plus matches deep into their AEW career, facing Swerve Strickland vs. Brody King, in the night's main event on Dynamite, rated 7.37 ? a well-paced, entertaining battle in a hard-fought men's division clash, part of the special Summer Blockbuster '26 - Night 1 card.

Rewind to 2026, when the AEW TNT Title was up for grabs as Kevin Knight vs. Myron Reed went to war, appearing on Collision, rated 7.41 ? a good, competitive contest. Every title match carries a little extra weight, and this one was no exception.

secondaries.text: Turning the clock back to 2026: it was the first-ever encounter between The Dogs (Connors & Finlay) and The Young Bucks on Collision, rated 7.65 ? a well-worked match.
It was 2026 when Jake Doyle vs. Mike Bailey met for the very first time on Collision, rated 7.30 ? a strong outing.
Turning the clock back to 2026: the AEW Continental Title was up for grabs as Jon Moxley vs. Shane Taylor went to war, appearing on Dynamite, rated 5.74.
